results.market_gap: A lightweight vendor-neutral compatibility/evidence ledger remains narrower than vendor procurement/configuration services.

competition_search_terms: general contractor drawing specification contradiction AI software
Türkiye müteahhit ihale dokümanı çelişki kontrol yazılımı
results.market_gap: A lightweight SMB-focused rulebook could differ from enterprise Kuro, but direct global competition clearly exists.
results.mvp: Document metadata/manual extracted clauses, contradiction register, reusable company rulebook, bid review and correction ledger.
results.working_logic: Users enter/import requirements and conflicts; confirmed corrections become reusable company rules for later bids.
results.marketing_strategy: Mid-sized general contractors and estimating consultancies.
results.first_customer_plan: Pilot on completed tender documents and compare surfaced contradictions.
results.main_risk: Automated PDF/DWG understanding at Kuro depth would require external AI; zero-cost MVP must stay structured/manual rather than promise equivalent AI extraction.
results.validation_assumption: MVP product is structured workflow and reusable rules, not full automated drawing intelligence.
